mechanism: Meprobamate may potentiate gentamicin's nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through additive CNS depression and reduced renal clearance, while gentamicin's nephrotoxicity can impair meprobamate elimination.
action: Monitor renal function, serum gentamicin levels, and audiometry; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; adjust meprobamate dosing based on renal status.
